description: This file defines the CParser class for parsing PDF content streams within the PDFsharp library. It includes multiple constructors for different input types, methods for parsing tokens and content objects, and references to PDF content objects and lexing components.

classes.name: CParser
classes.description: Provides the functionality to parse PDF content streams, including methods for token scanning and object parsing within a PDF page or content stream.

methods.name: CParser
methods.description: Constructors initializing CParser with various input types such as PdfPage, byte array, MemoryStream, or CLexer.

methods.name: ReadContent
methods.description: Reads and returns the entire content sequence from the PDF content stream.

methods.name: ParseObject
methods.description: Internal method that parses tokens into content objects until a stop symbol is encountered.

methods.name: CreateOperator
methods.description: Creates COperator instances from operator names or OpCodeName enums, with handling for inline images.

methods.name: ScanNextToken
methods.description: Scans and returns the next token's symbol from the lexer.

methods.name: ScanNextToken
methods.description: Overloaded method that also outputs the token string along with the token's symbol.

methods.name: ReadSymbol
methods.description: Reads and verifies that the next token matches a specified symbol.
